description: Implementation of the DrmMetadata class managing DRM metadata, including methods for adding, retrieving, and iterating over metadata entries.

classes.name: DrmMetadata
classes.description: Class managing DRM metadata key-value pairs with iteration capabilities.

classes.name: DrmMetadata::KeyIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing keys in DrmMetadata.

classes.name: DrmMetadata::Iterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing values in DrmMetadata.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of metadata entries.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the metadata map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key as String8.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the raw C-string value for a given key.

methods.name: getAsByteArray
methods.description: Returns the value as a byte array (C-string).

methods.name: keyIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the keys.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the values.
